connector.name: satoshidata - Bitcoin entity intelligence
connector.registryDescription: Bitcoin entity and risk-exposure evidence for AI agents; keyless MCP, no risk_check score/verdict.
connector.summary: Hosted at satoshidata.ai over streamable HTTP. Needs an API key you supply, and it reaches 8 of 9 clients tracked here.
connector.provenanceNote: Published under the verified namespace ai.satoshidata, which resolves to the same domain as the linked website. That pairing is the strongest ownership signal the registry exposes.
connector.authNote: A long lived key or token is required. Scope it as narrowly as the upstream service allows and rotate it on a schedule.

headers.name: X-WR-API-Key
headers.description: Optional satoshidata.ai API key for premium tools. Free tools work without it.
